game: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter
approach: The 360 default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue, with a game-specific runtime standing in for the Xbox.
notes: The console-exclusive Red Storm version, with the third-person camera and the Cross-Com drone. It boots on Windows to its Press Start screen; next is the campaign and its first mission. No game data included: bring your own Xbox 360 copy.
